__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB_CLOUD
__inputs.label: InfluxDB Cloud
__inputs.description: Select the existing Flux datasource during import

title: Synthetic Patient Monitoring — Live Presentation
description: Presentation view of the edge/cloud runtime path and a clearly labelled replay of governed benchmark results.

list.name: session
list.label: Presentation session
list.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "benchmark_demo_progress_v2" and r._field == "completed_cells")
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "presentation_session")
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

options.content:
## EDGE — local, durable, privacy-controlled
**Synthetic generators** → Protobuf → **NATS JetStream** → **Brain A/B/C scoring** → SQLite WAL outbox  
*Broker acknowledgement means the derived batch is durably local.*

⬇ **HTTPS batched delivery** — asynchronous, retryable, separately reconciled

## CLOUD — remote storage and observation
**InfluxDB Cloud** → Flux queries → **Grafana live dashboard**  
*A successful Influx write establishes cloud storage; Grafana is the observation layer.*

panels.title: Replay completion
panels.description: Presentation replay progress, not a new benchmark execution.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "benchmark_demo_progress_v2" and r._field == "completion_pct")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.presentation_session =~ /^${session:regex}$/ and r.evidence_mode == "replay")
  |> group()
  |> last()

panels.title: Completed benchmark cells
panels.description: Each cell is one scenario × signal seed × noise seed, with all three approaches.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "benchmark_demo_progress_v2" and r._field == "completed_cells")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.presentation_session =~ /^${session:regex}$/ and r.evidence_mode == "replay")
  |> group()
  |> last()

panels.title: Detection outcome as results arrive
panels.description: Run-level synthetic detection outcome (0 or 1), separated by scoring approach.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "benchmark_demo_v2" and r._field == "detection_run_rate")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.presentation_session =~ /^${session:regex}$/ and r.evidence_mode == "replay")
  |> group(columns: ["approach"])

panels.title: Detection latency as results arrive
panels.description: Synthetic event onset to first new alarm episode; absent values mean the run did not detect the event.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "benchmark_demo_v2" and r._field == "scoring_detection_latency_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.presentation_session =~ /^${session:regex}$/ and r.evidence_mode == "replay")
  |> group(columns: ["approach"])

panels.title: Alarm episodes per patient-day
panels.description: Operational alarm burden; lower is preferable only when interpreted together with detection.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "benchmark_demo_v2" and r._field == "alarm_episode_rate_per_patient_day")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.presentation_session =~ /^${session:regex}$/ and r.evidence_mode == "replay")
  |> group(columns: ["approach"])

panels.title: Latest replayed A/B/C result rows
panels.description: All values originate from the selected governed benchmark CSV; timestamps show replay order, not experiment time.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "benchmark_demo_v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.presentation_session =~ /^${session:regex}$/ and r.evidence_mode == "replay")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "detection_run_rate" or r._field == "scoring_detection_latency_ms" or r._field == "alarm_episode_rate_per_patient_day")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "run_id", "scenario", "approach"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 30)

options.content: **This screen replays completed synthetic benchmark evidence for presentation.** It does not rerun the experiment and its wall-clock timestamps are not benchmark timestamps. The defensible claim is a **detection-speed versus nuisance-alarm-burden trade-off under synthetic conditions**. It is not evidence of clinical effectiveness, 500-patient scale, or cloud suppression.
